characters.interactions_notes: Paul is the only character ever shown on screen; he addresses the camera directly for the entire piece, as if narrating a mantra/manifesto to 'all husbands'. The second character in the joke — presumably his wife — never appears visually and has no transcribed dialogue of her own; she exists only as an off-screen shouted 'PAUL!!!!!' text/sound cue that instantly punctures his monologue. The power dynamic is the entire gag: every line builds Paul up as dominant and in control, staged with increasingly grandiose settings (private library, corner office skyline, rooftop), and the single off-screen interruption collapses that persona in under a second, revealing he is actually meek and reactive toward the unseen wife. There is no real back-and-forth exchange; the 'interaction' is a one-line ambush that recontextualizes everything said before it.
